events.name: Theyyam season (North Malabar ritual performances)
events.place: Various shrines and kavus in North Malabar (Kannur & Kasaragod)
events.summary: Seasonal ritual‑theatre performances (Theyyam) at numerous kavus and village shrines across North Malabar—offering unique, living-ritual cultural experiences for visitors; dates and specific kavu schedules vary.

events.name: Kalpathi Ratholsavam (Kalpathi chariot festival)
events.summary: Annual ratholsavam (chariot) festival in the Kalpathi agraharam featuring processions, traditional music and cultural pageantry—of interest to visitors seeking heritage temple rituals.

events.name: Kayamkulam Boat Race (Champions Boat League leg)
events.summary: Kayamkulam leg of the Champions Boat League (snake‑boat racing)—a high‑energy vallam kali spectacle popular with visitors to the backwaters.

events.name: Kayamkulam Boat Race (Champions Boat League)
events.summary: Champions Boat League race at Kayamkulam — another major backwater race in the CBL calendar.

events.name: Sabarimala — Mandala Pooja season (Sree Ayyappa Temple)
events.summary: Sabarimala opens for the 41-day Mandala pilgrimage period — major pilgrimage season with special darshan arrangements; devotees should follow Travancore Devaswom / temple notices.

events.name: Sabarimala — Mandala Pooja season (Sabarimala opening for Mandala)
events.summary: The 41‑day Mandala pilgrimage season at Sabarimala, a major period for darshan and traditional observances—important for pilgrims and visitors observing temple rituals.

events.name: Guruvayur Ekadasi (Sri Krishna Temple)
events.summary: Ekadasi observance at Guruvayur Temple — an important temple day when visitors can observe traditional worship and temple activity.

events.name: Guruvayur Ekadasi (Vrischikam Ekadasi)
events.summary: Ekadashi observance at Guruvayur with special pujas and rituals—of interest to devotees and cultural visitors wanting to witness temple observances.

events.name: President's Trophy Boat Race (Ashtamudi Lake)
events.summary: President's Trophy boat race (season finale of Champions Boat League) on Ashtamudi Lake—spectacular snake‑boat regatta and a major viewing event for visitors.

events.name: President’s Trophy Boat Race (Ashtamudi)
events.summary: High-profile vallamkali event at Ashtamudi backwaters (President’s Trophy) — popular with visitors and often promoted by Kerala Tourism.

events.name: International Film Festival of Kerala (IFFK) — 31st edition
events.summary: Annual International Film Festival of Kerala featuring international and Indian cinema screenings, talks and events across venues in Thiruvananthapuram—key event for film enthusiasts.

events.name: International Film Festival of Kerala (IFFK), Thiruvananthapuram
events.summary: Annual international film festival organised by the Kerala State Chalachitra Academy — of interest to film and culture visitors (passes/registration required for some events).

events.name: Cochin Carnival (Fort Kochi / Kochi New Year carnival)
events.summary: Fort Kochi New Year carnival and street events culminating around New Year — lively cultural events for visitors in Kochi.

events.name: Cochin Carnival (Fort Kochi year‑end / New Year carnival)
events.summary: Fort Kochi's year‑end carnival culminating in the Pappanji effigy burning and New Year street events—colourful community competitions and parades enjoyable for visitors.

events.name: Sabarimala — Makaravilakku / Makara Jyothi phase
events.summary: Sabarimala re-opens for the Makaravilakku period with Makara Jyothi/Makaravilakku mid‑January as the pilgrimage high point.

events.name: Sabarimala — Makaravilakku / Makara Jyothi phase (Makaravilakku season)
events.summary: Makaravilakku / Makara Jyothi season at Sabarimala, including the Thiruvabharanam procession and the Makara Jyothi observance—one of the most important pilgrimage periods of the year.

events.name: Attukal Pongala (Attukal Bhagavathy Temple)
events.summary: Annual Attukal festival with the world-famous Pongala (women’s offering) as the main highlight — thousands of women prepare the offering; visitors often come to respectfully observe the scale and devotion.

events.name: Attukal Pongala (Attukal Bhagavathy Temple) — ten-day festival (Pongala main day)
events.summary: Ten-day Attukal festival culminating in the massive Pongala offering (women cook offering in public spaces) — Pongala main offering day is 2027-02-22.

events.name: Attukal Pongala (ten‑day Attukal Bhagavathy festival; Pongala main day)
events.summary: Ten‑day Attukal Bhagavathy festival in Thiruvananthapuram; the Pongala main day draws a massive all‑women offering event where participants cook offerings on temporary hearths—an extraordinary cultural spectacle.

events.name: Vishu (Malayalam New Year)
events.summary: Vishu, the Malayalam solar new‑year festival, marked by the Vishukkani ritual at dawn and family observances—an important cultural day to experience traditional Kerala rituals and feasts.

events.name: Thrissur Pooram
events.summary: Kerala's most famous temple pooram with caparisoned elephants, temple orchestra (melam) and the Kudamattam umbrella exchange—major cultural spectacle for visitors.

events.name: Thrissur Pooram (Vadakkunnathan Temple / Thekkinkadu Maidan)
events.summary: Kerala’s largest Pooram with elephant processions, Panchavadyam and the acclaimed kudamattam (parasol change) — major cultural spectacle.

events.name: Karkidaka Chikitsa (Ayurveda monsoon treatment period)
events.place: Statewide (Ayurvedic centres: Kottakkal, Varkala, Kovalam, Wayanad, etc.)
events.summary: Traditional Karkidaka (monsoon) period recommended for Ayurvedic rejuvenation treatments — many centres offer seasonal programmes aimed at wellness-seeking visitors.

events.name: Karkidaka Chikitsa (Ayurveda monsoon treatment season)
events.place: Statewide (Ayurvedic centres such as Kottakkal, Varkala, Kovalam, Wayanad, etc.)
events.summary: Monsoon Ayurveda treatment period (Karkidakam) when many Ayurvedic centres run special therapeutic packages—key season for wellness tourism in Kerala.

events.name: Nehru Trophy Boat Race (Punnamada Lake, Alappuzha) — (usual rule: second Saturday of August)
events.summary: Kerala’s famous single-day snake-boat race at Punnamada — a major backwaters event typically held on the second Saturday of August and popular with visitors during the season.

events.name: Nehru Trophy Boat Race (Punnamada Lake, Alappuzha) — expected date rule
events.summary: Kerala’s most famous snake-boat race, traditionally held on the second Saturday of August — hugely popular during the Onam season (confirm with Alappuzha district announcements).

events.name: Nehru Trophy Boat Race (Punnamada Lake)
events.summary: The signature Punnamada snake‑boat race (Nehru Trophy), one of Kerala's largest vallam kali events and a major tourist draw, traditionally held on the second Saturday of August.

events.name: Onam (Ten-day festival; Thiruvonam main day)
events.place: Statewide (major events in Alappuzha for boat-races and floral decorations)
events.summary: Kerala’s principal harvest/homecoming festival with pookalam, sadya and local events; Thiruvonam (main day) is on 2027-09-12 — an excellent period to experience statewide cultural traditions.

events.name: Onam (ten‑day celebrations; Thiruvonam main day)
events.place: Statewide (major events in Alappuzha, Thrissur, Thiruvananthapuram)
events.summary: Onam, Kerala's harvest festival with pookalam flower carpets, grand sadya feasts, boat races and widespread public celebrations—one of the state's biggest festival periods.
